name: idlemem
description: MEMORY AT AN IDLE PROMPT, the shared libc SP5 measure (spec section 1).  After the boot settles, vmstat -m prints the kernel heap's tables, the Memory Manager block table (boot claim, arena growth, user grants) and the Memory Manager's own TOTAL/FREE/MAXBLK; the coremap region is the 56-bank user pool's page map: free pieces of 4 bytes {size, address} in 256-byte pages, size 0 ending it (src/kernel/bank.s), so banks in use = 56 - free pages / 256.  A probe for measurement, not a pass/fail gate: it asserts only that the readout reached the screen.
